name: kat-platform-prism
title: Platform Prism
purpose: Answer each decision a content-addressed platform asks of its engineers, operators, security team and leaders, from conformance to rollout, by the app that models it, with every stated property proved in Lean.

promise.headline: Every platform decision, proved before it ships.
promise.detail: Nine decision apps in one verified guest: conformance verdicts, kappa-label checks, upload sessions, GC eviction, VM image admission, the rollout gate, the router that sends each stakeholder's question to the decision that answers it, and the front end and backend layers that decide what each view shows and what serves it.
